summary: Provision privileged review Confluence space + partner Slack channel gateway with timebound reviewer groups and automation
description:
Issue summary: Request to create a new Confluence space for 'Privileged Reviews' (security/privacy evidence and sign-offs) and an associated Slack channel gateway for approved external partners. The space should have a timebound auditor reviewer group, strict page-level permissions, and an automated daily snapshot retention that exports evidence to the legal vault. The Slack side should provision a read-only channel for partners via an approval workflow and a bot that enforces ephemeral membership (auto-removal after 30 days).

Impact: Several upcoming partner integrations require a secure, auditable collaboration surface where partners can view design docs and evidence without access to internal edit permissions. Current workaround is sharing documents manually which increases audit burden and risks stale permissions. This blocks partner onboarding timelines for two partner pilots starting next quarter.

Request details:
- Confluence: create space key PRVREV (title: Privileged Reviews).
  - Space permissions: only members of 'security-priv-reviewers' (timebound group), Legal-SLM, and space-admins can edit. Partner groups must be granted view-only on selected pages.
  - Create page templates: Evidence Checklist, Review Sign-off, Export Snapshot Job.
  - Configure automation: nightly snapshot that exports pages tagged "evidence" to a read-only export in the existing legal vault space; snapshots should include page history and attachments. Retention policy: retain 7 years.
- Jira: create a lightweight project or permission scheme mapping so reviewers can raise follow-up issues into INT project with minimal cross-perm friction.
- Slack: create a channel provisioning gateway that:
  - Creates a partner-specific channel e.g., #partner-acme-readonly (naming enforced).
  - Adds approved partner email domains via SCIM or invite flow, but members are added with a read-only role via the bot (no posting).
  - Enforce auto-removal of external members after 30 days unless renewed by the requester.
  - Audit logs forwarded to #security-audit and linked Confluence snapshots.

Desired automation/approval flow: Requesters fill a short form (Confluence page or Jira issue) that triggers an Ops bot to: validate requester, create space/page scaffolding, provision Slack channel, and kick off the nightly snapshot job. Admins should be able to revoke partner access centrally and see audit records.

Acceptance criteria:
- New Confluence space PRVREV exists with correct permission schema and templates.
- Nightly export automation is implemented and runs on staging for two nights with successful exports.
- Slack partner channel gateway can create a read-only partner channel and remove external members automatically after 30 days.
- Audit logs from both systems are visible in #security-audit and cross-linked on the Confluence snapshot pages.

Risks and considerations: must ensure export automation does not transmit PII outside approved vault. Coordinate with Security and Legal before enabling snapshots for real partner data. SCIM invites require approval from Identity team.
